How I can help you

I work with many clinics and hospitals in Istanbul. I choose the doctor for each patient individually.

  • Dentistry

    Hollywood Smile · Veneers · Crowns · Implants

    The most common reason my patients come. From single crowns to a complete smile makeover.

    5–10 days typical stay for veneers and crowns

  • Plastic surgery

    Face · Nose · Breasts · Body

    Face and body procedures with experienced surgeons. I am with you during recovery too.

    7–10 days typical stay for most procedures

  • Hair transplant

    Hair · Beard · Eyebrows

    Istanbul is one of the world's most popular places for a hair transplant. I help you choose a doctor you can trust.

    2–3 days in Istanbul are usually enough

  • Bariatric surgery

    Gastric sleeve · Bypass · Balloon

    Weight-loss surgery after medical assessment. We stay in touch after you get home.

    5–7 days typical stay in Istanbul

  • Eye surgery

    Laser vision correction · Cataract · Lens replacement

    Laser vision correction and other eye procedures. I choose the centre for your case.

    3–4 days typical stay in Istanbul

My name is Irena

I'm Ukrainian. I lived in Poland for 15 years and have lived in Istanbul for 22. I speak Polish, Ukrainian, Russian and Turkish, so not a word the doctor says gets lost in translation.

I have helped more than a thousand patients from all over Europe. Many come back to me for further treatment and recommend me to their families and friends. Your health matters most to me.

I love people. Your health matters most to me, which is why I treat every patient with responsibility and warmth.

Get to know me

From the airport to your door

I am with you at every stage. This is what your journey looks like, step by step.

1 / 5

  1. Consultation

    You message me on WhatsApp and send photos or test results. We talk, by video too, and I choose the clinic and the doctor. You receive a plan and a quote.

  2. Arrival

    I meet you at the airport. Your hotel and transfers are already booked, so there is nothing to worry about.

  3. Treatment

    I am with you at the clinic and interpret every conversation with the doctor. You can ask about anything.

  4. Your stay

    Throughout your stay I am available 24 hours a day. If you come with someone close to you, I look after them too.

  5. Going home

    Your transfer to the airport is arranged. Once you are home, we stay in touch.

Patient guide to Istanbul

Questions

Can't find your question? Message me and I'll reply within 24 hours.

Ask a question All questions
How much does your help cost?

Nothing for you. The consultation and my care are free. You only pay for treatment and your stay, according to the quote you receive before you travel.

Why are there no clinic names on the website?

I work with many clinics and hospitals in Istanbul and choose the doctor for each patient. After the consultation I tell you exactly where and with whom you will be treated.

How long will I stay in Istanbul?

It depends on the treatment. You receive a day-by-day plan for your stay after the consultation.

Do I need a visa?

Citizens of most EU countries, including Poland, can stay in Turkey visa-free for up to 90 days. If you are not sure about your country, ask me.

Can I bring someone with me?

Of course. About half of my patients come with someone close to them.

Which languages do you speak?

Polish, Ukrainian, Russian and Turkish, and some English. At the clinic I interpret every conversation with the doctor.
